newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Bosnia Serb ex-vice president dies of gun wound.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia Serb ex-vice president dies of gun wound.

text.p: Former Bosnian Serb vice-president Nikola Koljevic, who shot himself in the head nine days ago, died of his wounds on Saturday, the Yugoslav state-run Tanjug news agency said.
Koljevic, 60, a Shakespeare scholar and former Sarajevo university professor, had been in a coma since shooting himself in his office in Pale, a mountain village near Sarajevo, on January 16.
Koljevic, who was under treatment in a Belgrade hospital, "died in Belgrade on Saturday as the result of a self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head", Tanjug said.
Koljevic was evacuated to Belgrade, capital of neighbouring Serbia, in a French helicopter provided by the NATO-led peacekeeping force in Bosnia.
During the war Koljevic, thanks to his excellent English and his moderate image, was often chosen by the Bosnian Serbs to represent them with foreign officials.
